title: Member Services Training Notes: Age of an Energy Assistance Pledge Held Out of a Payment Arrangement
content:
**Member services training — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements): how long a held-back pledge stays held back**

**The rule.** How much of the pledge share held back from the amount moved into the agreement stays held back follows the pledge's age:

- where the pledge was recorded within the pledge hold days of the service account's rate schedule (under Electric Service by Rate Schedule) before the transfer day, all of it stays held back;
- where it is older than that but within the tier's pledge lookback of 90 calendar days, 50 percent (0.5) of it stays held back;
- where no pledge was recorded within that lookback, none.

**Questions answered in training**

*How is the age counted?* In calendar days from the pledge's recording date on the service account to the transfer day.

*What is the hold-days figure?* The pledge hold days set for the rate schedule of the service account; it is read from the rate schedule, not from the agreement's tier.

*Does the 90-day lookback differ by tier?* No. Every tier of Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements) carries a 90-day pledge lookback.

**Hypothetical (rate schedule with 30 pledge hold days), pledge share held back of $150.00**

| Pledge age on the transfer day | Stays held back |
|---|---|
| 30 days | $150.00 |
| 31 days | $75.00 |
| 90 days | $75.00 |
| 91 days | nothing |
